details: @myorder-frontend-commons/analytics is a dependency-confusion package published to the public npm scope @myorder-frontend-commons, with an index.js that exports stub functions under the name of an internal package. Its preinstall, install and postinstall scripts all run `node poc.js`, which collects the hostname, username, OS platform/arch/release, working directory, Node version and the names of set CI environment variables, and sends them by HTTP GET to a hex-encoded subdomain of db69ak0hu4nqhtf9omnguspxhjk8kuide.oast.fun and to 80-190-83-27.nip.io. The npm account piotrbsf published 101.0.0 on 2026-10-12 with the same payload as the 12 earlier versions already in MAL-2026-17749, changing only the Interactsh subdomain (previously db4jftohu4noreqdanngpnb3ger45ykrt.oast.fun) and the beacon token.
